evidence: Legacy no-split results retain strong diagonal fish-scale patterns, so adaptive split can amplify but is not required to create the artifact. Observation-aware EMA improves geometry modestly but does not reduce overlap or the visual pattern.
goal: Determine whether fish-scale support is created by early mean, normal-basis, or scale optimization under view-limited image gradients, and whether stronger per-update multi-view consensus reduces it.
baseline: v10 combined_margin2: observation-aware EMA, observation-weighted support, 2-pixel FOV margin, offset-SDF gradient blend 0.50.

variants.freeze_normals: disable normal/basis optimizer gradients and PCA refresh
variants.freeze_covariance: disable normal and scale optimizer gradients; no PCA refresh
variants.delay_means_b: enable mean gradients at Stage B
variants.delay_covariance_b: enable normal and scale gradients at Stage B
variants.delay_all_geometry_b: enable means, normals and scales at Stage B
variants.delay_covariance_c: enable normal and scale gradients at Stage C
variants.delay_all_geometry_c: enable all geometry gradients at Stage C
variants.multiview16: double views per update from 8 to 16

fixed: Complete K4 preset, seed 42, 12k, four stages, 240 training views, identical support/SDF/split settings and evaluation protocol.
parallel_policy: Exactly ten training variants submitted concurrently on the 24GB RTX 3090 with expandable CUDA segments enabled.
